title: Dignited (2019): Export a Wikipedia page as a PDF

steps.quote: Locate the **Print/export** section in the left panel of the page.
steps.text: Locate the Print/export section in the left panel of the page.
steps.goal: The article's print and export options are shown

steps.quote: Select **Download as PDF** from the list.
steps.text: Select Download as PDF from the list.
steps.goal: A page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown
